experiments.paper_location: Section 4.3 Equations 9-11; Section 4.4 attention execution support
experiments.mechanism: Actual selected sparse/full QK, probability correction, Softmax, weighted-value and server bodies against independent dense FP64 expectations on supplied candidate multisets.

conditions.execution: portable software FP32 lanes; optional capability-gated actual AVX512F/FMA selected arithmetic
conditions.seed: fixed deterministic literal formulas, no RNG
conditions.sparse: two layers, two batches, two KV heads, two query groups; dimensions 16/32/128; nnz 1/15/16/17/31/32; valid capacity 32 and initialized padding; distinct unsorted or repeated candidate IDs
conditions.full: dimension 128 only; query groups 1/4/8; uniform nnz 16/32 per KV/query head; two batches and two KV heads
conditions.oracle: Independent arithmetic BF16 decoding, dense FP64 dots/norms, explicitly enumerated Binomial(4,p) >=2 with K=3, released +1e-4 regularizer, normalization, weighted V and base-2 maximum/LSE.
conditions.bf16_adapter: Explicit finite-value software dependency model: pinned FBGEMM uint32 bits+0x8000 then >>16, not ties-even. Actual FBGEMM intrinsics, dispatch and linkage untested.
conditions.tensor_adapter: Explicit non-owning contiguous std-only buffers; queries already FP32; Tensor.to is identity. No Torch dtype conversion, ABI or allocation claim.
conditions.threading: OpenMP pragmas execute serially without OpenMP runtime; production scheduling/races untested
conditions.tolerances: pre-Softmax corrected scores 3e-5 on both modes; portable probability 3e-5, output 0.004 including BF16 quantization, base2 metadata 5e-5; native probability 0.002, output 0.008, metadata 0.03 as existing polynomial bootstrap budget
conditions.native_capabilities: AVX512F and FMA with confirmed GCC CPU/OS gate before execution

experiments.note: Support characterization, not exact paper replication or end-to-end LSH/model validation. Actual same-data all-candidate corrected sparse and dense pipelines each match their own oracle and differ as expected because inclusion correction remains. fill copies storage; getter views alias live server; clear is observed through existing views; alloc called once per server and destructor sanitizer checked.

experiments.paper_location: Sections 4.3-4.4; released CPU kernel capacity/dimension support boundaries
experiments.mechanism: Defined-memory characterization of rounded QK score writes, full-Softmax padded mutation, unsupported dimension tails and full-WV query groups.

conditions.capacity: Both indices and scores allocated to round_up(nnz,16); initialized score padding and valid row IDs; guards after capacity
conditions.padding_observation: qk_kernel zeros only nnz but accumulates through round_up(nnz,16), preserving prior padding value; softmax_kernel_full scales/normalizes padded slots while valid probabilities remain correct
conditions.dimension_observation: QK dimension17 ignores a nonzero last coordinate; WV dimension17 leaves last output untouched
conditions.full_group_observation: wv_kernel_dim128_full group2 returns silently without output writes; supported full server tests restrict groups1/4/8 and dimension128
conditions.empty_candidates: not called here; unsafe empty behavior is characterized separately
conditions.invalid_parameters: not validated by maintained server; unsupported capacity, dimension, layer/request, divisibility, reallocation and expired views are not claimed safe
conditions.varying_gqa_lengths_observation: Actual full server with groups4/KVheads2 and query lengths [16,16,16,16,32,32,32,32], zero logits and BF16 values1 produces head4 output0.5 versus independent dense1. KV-indexed nnz in QK/WV differs from query-indexed nnz in Softmax; verified full support remains uniform lengths only.

experiments.note: Reports observed restrictions rather than a repair. Maintained arithmetic remains unchanged. Padded capacity is a caller precondition; nnz-sized buffers are not asserted safe. Corrected sparse all-candidate support differs from dense full attention.
